articleTitle: Pilot scheduling based on water-filling algorithm in massive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Pilot contamination becomes a bottleneck of performance improvement in massive MIMO (multiple-input-multipleoutput) multiple-cell system, due to the signal interference coming from the users that reuse the same pilots in the adjacent cells. Therefore, it is necessary to explore effective approaches to reduce the inter-cell signals interference in order to increase the whole system capacity for massive MIMO. Few former schemes, which are used to mitigate pilot contamination, consider the specific characteristics of the different channels and the interfering degree of different pilots. In this paper, we take these characters into consideration and propose a low-complexity pilot scheduling scheme by applying water-filling algorithm to improve the cell sum-rate. We assign these pilots that are less interference to the users with favourable wireless channel states, and assign severely interfering pilots to the users with inferior channel states. From the perspective of the whole system capacity, pilot contamination can be largely reduced with the proposed scheme, and the system sum-rate can be significantly increased. The simulation results verify the proposed pilot scheduling scheme.

articleTitle: A smart low-consumption IoT framework for location tracking and its real application
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Location-based services are increasingly popular. Smart devices embedded with GPS receiver are widely used in vehicle tracking, law enforcement and person monitoring. To provide real-time data collecting and analyzing, a backend server is necessary. A mobile app can work as a user client for accessing location data and remote control. In this paper, we describe the design and implementation of a system providing real-time positioning and tracking service. Our system consists of three parts: tracking device, backend server and mobile app. Our tracking device integrates GPS module, GSM/GPRS module and TCP/IP stack, capable of generating location data, establishing TCP connection and receiving SMS. Location data are transmitted over TCP connection from device to our backend server. The server is responsible for collecting and storing data. The server also provides an HTTP-based RESTful API for mobile app and web service. A mobile app is built for displaying data and controlling device remotely. Data accessing is via calling REST API and remote control is sent to device by SMS. Our device is compact in volume, accurate in positioning, and long in battery life. Our device has been integrated in a walking stick as a real-world product.

articleTitle: A novel location privacy preserving scheme for spatial crowdsourcing
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to avoid disclosing the location privacy of the workers to the requester and the server in spatial crowdsourcing, we propose a novel location privacy preserving scheme. In the scheme, the registered online workers execute the distributed spatial clustering algorithm and the coordinate of each virtual cluster center is reported to the server by each cluster head. Base on the proposed clustering algorithm, we introduce a two-level spatial task assignment algorithm which includes the primary assignment phase and secondary assignment phase executed by the server and the cluster head, respectively. The simulation results indicate that the proposed scheme can effectively accomplish the spatial task assignment without compromising the location privacy of the workers.

articleTitle: Specific Emitter Identification based on linear polynomial fitting of the energy envelope
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Specific Emitter Identification (SEI) is the technique that identifies the individual radio emitter using the Radio Frequency Fingerprint (RFF), which are originated from the imperfections and differences of transmitters. Previous SEI techniques are sensitive to noise and need enough sampled points. In this paper, a novel SEI approach to extracting fingerprint features of energy envelope of transient signals is proposed. A linear system model is utilized to fit the energy envelope, and the fingerprinting features are constructed by the polynomial coefficients estimated with least-squares algorithm. The results of experiments on actual burst signals demonstrate that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Enhanced listen-before-talk scheme for LTE in unlicensed band
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Extending LTE technology to unlicensed band 5GHz is a research focus to alleviate the problem of scarce spectrum resource. Listen-before-talk (LBT) scheme is necessary in unlicensed band to ensure the fair utilization of spectrum resource among different radio access technologies (RATs). Aiming at overcoming the drawbacks that there are limited opportunities and fixed location for clear channel assessment (CCA) to sense channel in LBT scheme, we propose an enhanced LBT scheme with performing random back-off process and adjusting the times of sensing channel according to the state of channel for LTE with Licensed-Assisted Access (LTE-LAA) to achieve the fairness of channel access. Moreover, we also propose a model in which applies enhanced LBT scheme to calculate the throughput for APs and LTE small cells in the coexistence of WIFI and LTE. Simulation results show that enhanced LBT scheme can solve the problem that the throughput of WIFI is constrained by LTE which uses original LBT scheme in the WIFI-LTE coexistence scenario. Moreover, compared to original LBT scheme, our enhanced LBT scheme can also solve the problem that only one operator can transmit in the coexistence of LTE and LTE deployed by different operators.

articleTitle: A weighted least squares source localization algorithm using TDOA measurements in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel weighted least squares (WLS) algorithm for a single static source localization in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) using time difference of arrival (TDOA). Owing to the nonlinearity of the original distance difference equations derived from TDOA, it is difficult to estimate the location directly. So we first establish a new linearizing approach to give a closed-form solution. By taking a node as reference, all the equations share the same term as the range between the source and the reference node. Utilizing simple algebraic means, the same term can be eliminated with equations transformed into linear formulas. We further analyze the noise component in the formulas and develop a WLS solution to estimate the single source's coordinate. Simulation results show that the proposed method outperforms the existing closed-form GS method.

articleTitle: Optical fibers with high birefringence as a sensor element
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The polarization maintaining fiber (PMF) sensitivity during excitation of both polarization modes is the principle of this sensor function. This excitation is caused by temperature change and by absorbing of thermal radiation. This mechanism is used for detection of temperature field disturbance as an indicator. This article describes experimental tests to determine PM fibers Panda style responses made by applying of thermal source with different initial temperature. The aim of this study was to determine the sensitivity of PMF to radiating heat, to upgrade the space configuration and time response.

articleTitle: Vehicles relative positioning based on ZigBee and GPS technology
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Traditional on-board sensors such as camera, radar and LiDAR (light detection and ranging) cannot fully perceive surrounding environment or function well under severe weather like V2V technology does. For instance, millimeter wave radar based adaptive cruise control system does not perform well when host vehicle is driving from straight line into a curve. Forward collision warning system becomes invalid once encountering heavy fog or heavy snow weather. In contrast, V2V technology is not only applicable to various weather but also with further detecting range than radar and LiDAR, which seems more attractive and feasible to handle more types of driving circumstances. This paper first tested GPS positioning accuracy under campus environment, then used ZigBee to exchange information (speed, heading and brake status, etc.) between vehicles, and eventually this paper accomplished relative positioning by combining GPS and V2V technologies.

articleTitle: Delay and collision optimization for clustered machine type communications in random access procedures
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, a clustered random access scheme based on packet aggregation method for machine type communication (MTC) is proposed, for which MTC devices are divided into clusters according to their locations. The neighboring devices are assigned to the same cluster. Devices within a group can communicate to each other by Device-to-Device (D2D) communication methods. The newly generated packets by MTC devices are transferred to the machine whose number of packets in the buffer is the closest to the given threshold in the group, which leads to shorter waiting time of packets in the buffer. Simulation results show that, the proposed scheme can significantly decrease collision probability and average delay of the random access procedure in machine type communications.

articleTitle: Optical fault injection attacks for flash memory of smartcards
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Flash memory, as a storage medium, is normally featured with high security, and thus often contains sensitive data such as passwords, cryptographic keys and other confidential contents. Optical fault injection attack is a conventional way that aims at extracting the information stored on memories. However, it has not been developed yet using this method to attack flash memories of modern micro smartcards. In this paper, the attack on flashes with optical fault injection is analyzed theoretically, and the experimental process is presented in detail. Experimental results show that some certain bytes of data can be changed into known value with optical fault injection attacks. In the read/write process, some secure information can be obtained by this approach of attack. The feature of the fault injection attack on flashes shown in the experiment can be utilized to bypass the verify operation of certain changed bytes and to guess the remaining original bytes to gain contents stored in non-volatile memories.

articleTitle: Combining deep learning with rough set analysis: A model of cyberspace situational awareness
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: A cyberspace situational awareness (CSA) model, DLRSA model, is proposed in this paper, with feature extraction based on deep learning (DL) and situation assessment based on rough set analysis (SARSA). We focus on network flow instead of server logs of IDS to extract features, transforming source data into information and establishing knowledge base. On account of Gaussian-Bernoulli deep belief network (GBDBN), accurate feature information is provided for assessment. While DLRSA model assesses situation in reference to pattern recognition, assessment strategy could be given by rough set analysis and pattern information abstracted deeply. Experiments indicate that DLRSA model has low extraction error and succinct assessment rule.

articleTitle: OPTMR: Optimal data flow graph partitioning for triple modular redundancy against hardware Trojan in reconfigurable hardware
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Hardware Trojans have become a significant threat to computing reliability and data security in reconfigurable hardware. One of the most effective techniques of run-time detection and recovery is based on Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) mechanism; however, this mechanism causes a large resource overhead because the protected circuit needs to be totally duplicated twice for detection stage and decision stage. This paper proposes a novel methodology called Optimal Partitioning Triple Modular Redundancy (OPTMR) that optimizes the Data Flow Graph (DFG) partitioning to reduce the total overhead of TMR. The mathematical relationship between DFG partitioning and total overhead is discussed and the principle of DFG node division is presented. The efficiency and effectiveness of OPTMR is verified through simulation on an actual Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) device.

articleTitle: A robust video watermarking scheme to scalable recompression and transcoding
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, we present a simple but effective video watermarking scheme robust enough against scalable lossy recompression and transcoding. Most of video watermarking algorithms use DCT or DWT, but few of those method can withstand scalable recompression or transcoding. Algorithms with DWT and DCT usually based on specific encoding format, so the watermark will be lost after transform embedded video to other encoding formats. In our method, we use scene change to choose frames to embed watermark, so it can resist attack of aimless frame dropping. We use Arnold transformation to enhance the imperceptibility of the watermark. Our watermark is a fixed-size binary image, after Arnold transformation, it is uniformly embedded to the chosen frames by a spatial random mapping algorithm. The watermark after embedding to the frame has a high imperceptibility. The proposed algorithm allows blind detection without use of origin video. The embedded watermark can be extracted in a low resolution video recompressed from an embedded high resolution video or transcoded from other format embedded video.

articleTitle: Design and application of data integration platform based on web services and XML
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: At present, each department in large enterprises has already setup a large number of databases on Internet. But these databases lack the information sharing each other, forming the detached island of information; therefore enterprise data integration becomes more and more important. This paper presents a data integration and exchange framework under distributed heterogeneous environment based on web services and XML. The detailed functions of the framework are described. The methods are totally implemented in the data integration platform of the housing fund for eliminating isolated information islands.

articleTitle: Low complexity signal detector based on Lanczos method for large-scale MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, linear minimum mean square error (MMSE) method is one of the most near-optimal ways for signal detection. However, MMSE involves matrix inversion which is of high complexity for computation. In this paper, a Lanczos-based method is proposed to solve the problem by transferring the matrix inversion computation into an iteration process of solving a linear equation. The simulation result proves that the BER of Lanczos-based method outperforms the recently proposed Neumann series approximation algorithm with the same SNR. At the same time, the Lanczos-based method could reduce the computational complexity from O(K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) to O(K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), where K is the number of users. Then the convergence speed is analysed by Kaniel-Paige-Saad theory. Finally, the result shows that the performance of Lanczos-based method achieves the classical MMSE exact matrix inversion methods with only a small number of iterations.

articleTitle: Symbol-by-symbol detection for faster-than-Nyquist signaling aided with frequency-domain precoding
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Faster-than-Nyquist signaling is a promising waveform scheme in the fifth generation mobile communications for achieving higher spectrum efficiency. However, the FTN-caused intentional intersymbol interference will make the dectection process more complex. In this paper, a new precoding scheme is proposed for faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) signaling system aiming at reducing the burden of the receiver. Aided with the proposed frequency-domain precoding at the transmitter, the receiver can estimate the transmitted symbols by performing the symbol-by-symbol detection, which reduces the detection complexity dramatically. Moreover, the proposed precoding method can be applied into the high-order modulation directly, such as M-PSK or M-QAM. Further, the performance of proposed precoding scheme for FTN is verified and tested. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed precoding scheme can not only realize symbol-by-symbol detection without bit-error-rate (BER) loss but also not broaden the spectrum of FTN signal at the transmitter.

articleTitle: Design of global emergency mobile communication system based on TDRSS
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Global emergency mobile communication system proposed in this paper can accomplish realtime call and text message communication based on TDRSS. It can be applied to ocean sailing, disaster relief, landing ground searching. System constructure and operational mode are designed. The design scheme of the mobile terminal is also proposed in this paper. Multi-user capacity is analyzed through calculation and simulation.

articleTitle: A novel reliable broadcast protocol for VANET's safety applications
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In IEEE1609.4/IEEE 802.11p for vehicular ad hoc network (VANET), periodic broadcasting of status messages on the control channel (CCH) can realize collision avoidance, accident early warning and many other safety applications, which has attracted a great deal of attention in recent years. However, because IEEE 802.11p broadcast mode for VANETS has no acknowledgement mechanism and its contention window (CW) cannot be adjusted with vehicles density, collision probability is high and broadcast success rate is low. For this reason, a novel reliable broadcast protocol is designed, which consists of three kinds of mechanisms: Geographical-Location-Based Asynchronous Time Division Multiplexing (GLATDM), Chanel-State-Feedback-Based Back-off (CSFB) and Adaptive Dynamic Contention Window (ADCW). GLATDM is proposed to avoid hidden nodes problem. CSFB mechanism can assure vehicles know whether their broadcast packets have been set successfully or not and when to retransmit. Following by ADCW scheme, vehicles can adjust their CW size based on the vehicles number. An analytical model has also been built. Simulation results validated the accuracy of the model and effectiveness of the protocol. The proposal can assure vehicles have higher broadcast success rate, lower collision rate and average access delay. Besides, the CCH occupancy rate is lower, which can save more channel resource for other services.

articleTitle: Improving channel assignment in wireless mesh network with linear programming
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For multi-radio multi-channel wireless mesh networks (WMNs), the joint channel assignment and routing problem has been shown to be NP-complete. In this paper, we first use a rate-variable model to increase the network through output, which use the physical interference model that can evaluate the capacity more precisely. Then we present a mathematical programming model which allows us to formulate the task of deriving joint channel assignment and routing as an integer linear programming problem. Simulation results show that the proposed approach effectively increases the network through output.

articleTitle: The research of the information security base on the intergrated carrying platform
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the building and using of the center integrated communication carrying platform, the information security problem with the multi-project parallel especially remarkable. In this paper, author discuss the information security mechanism adapt to the center characteristic with the constraint condition of the multi-project parallel.

articleTitle: Demodulation of continuous phase 2FSK signal with Gardner synchronization
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new method of demodulation of continuous phase binary FSK signal is presented, during FSK demodulation, the FSK signal produces In-phase signal (I(t)) and Quadrature signal (Q(t)). And method of Gardner synchronization is used for bit synchronization. When using Gardner synchronization, some changes must be made so that it is suitable for FSK demodulation. It can resist 7% of frequency deviation. And it gets lower bit error rate than traditional method of coherent demodulation when SNR is the same. What's more, there is only 0.1dB SNR loss, 9.78 dB to 9.88 dB, when the bit error rate is 1e-3 when we compare demodulation with Gardner synchronization to optimal receiver demodulation.

articleTitle: Supervised dimensionality reduction that preserves both global and local information
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Dimensionality reduction is a problem of fundamental importance in both machine learning and data mining. In this paper, we develop a new approach that can process labeled datasets and accurately reduce their dimensionalities. The approach is based on a new objective that contains information from both the global and local structures of a data set. An iterative approach is used to compute the directions along which the objective can be optimized. Experiments on benchmark data sets show that both the global and local information in a dataset can be effectively captured by this approach and it is thus able to provide more accurate results for dimensionality reduction than some existing approaches.

articleTitle: A 76 mW 40-Gb/s SerDes transmitter with 64:1 MUX In 65-nm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a fully-integrated wireline transmitter operating at 40Gb/s. The transmitter incorporates a combiner of 64:1 MUX and 2-tap Feed-Forward-Equalizer (FFE). The transmitter is achieved in 65nm CMOS technology. The simulation results show that the proposed transmitter can work at 40Gb/s with a -11dB RLGC channel. The simulation power consumption is 76 mW under 1.08V supply, and the core area is 0.217 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Stock correlation analysis based on complex network
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Aim at the study of the relationship of correlation between the stocks of SSE(Shanghai Stock Exchange) companies and the movement of SSE complex index, by using the mathematical statistics method and correlation coefficient analysis, select each stock's daily closing price as object, establish the complex network of stocks. Through preprocessing the data sets, we used R Studio get the mean correlation coefficient matrix, which is the foundation of the financial network. The results confirm the utility of the correlation coefficient analysis as a stability indicator for SSE stock market, since it proves that the correlation of stocks is different according to the crisis and prosperous of stock market in times. Its development is opposite to the market index, the interaction between the stocks attenuates when the complex index rises and enhances when the index falls. We also used K-means clustering algorithm to classify these nodes into different communities and found that the structures of networks vary widely according to their correlations. The method of this paper and the model it proposed is not only for the selection of our data sets, but also can be generalized to other fields of research.

articleTitle: Irregular mapping design for bit-interleaved coded modulation with low complexity iterative decoding
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Bit-interleaved coded modulation with iterative decoding (BICM-ID) is an effective technology to approach the channel capacity for high-order modulations, which makes it especially fit for the circumstances where both efficient code rate and superior performance are needed, such as bandwidth limited wireless broadcasting or mobile communications. However, to achieve the target of near capacity decoding, many times of iteration is assumed, which heavily adds complexity to the receiving side. If the times of iteration lowers down, considerable degradation could be observed. The design rules of near capacity decoding cannot generally guarantee a still acceptable performance for a few times of iteration. In this paper, to lessen the decoding complexity, an irregular mapping design aiming at maximizing the extrinsic mutual information after a fixed times of iteration is studied. And the simulations show that our method obtains coding gains from 0.4 dB to 1.2 dB at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> compared to other known mappings on condition of 4 times of iteration.

articleTitle: Background modeling for dynamic scenes using tensor decomposition
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Background modeling is an important topic in video analysis and understanding, while the main difficulty lies in the dynamic scenes. The scenes with limited variation can be effectively described by numerous models, but more precise representation model are needed for complex scenes. In this paper, we propose a background modeling algorithm for dynamic scenes using tensor decomposition. Since video data can be naturally represent as higher-order tensors, the tensor methods can accurately describe the dynamic nature of the nearby pixels, and then background will be estimated by the low-rank representation of tensors. Experimental results show that the proposed method is robust and adaptive in dynamic environments, and furthermore, moving objects can be clearly separated from the complex dynamic background.

articleTitle: Aperiodic complementary sequence sets with zero correlation zone over 8-QAM+ constellation
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Aperiodic complementary sequence sets (ACSS) with zero correlation zone (ZCZ) over 8-QAM+ constellation are defined as 8-QAM+ Z-ACSS. New shift vectors and mappings are used to transform perfect ternary sequences to 8-QAM+ orthogonal sequences, meanwhile based on p-phase orthogonal sequence sets, p=2, 3, 4, 8-QAM+ Z-ACSS are constructed by interleaving operation in this paper. The parameters of the resultant 8-QAM+Z-ACSS can be set flexibly to achieve the theoretical bound, which means the Z-ACSS proposed are optimal. 8-QAM+ Z-ACSS can be used in quasi-synchronous CDMA (QS-CDMA) communication systems with high transmission data rate (TDR) and multi-users to remove the multiple access interference (MAI) and multi-path interference (MPI).

articleTitle: Optimization of hierarchical data fusion in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In Wireless Sensory Networks (WSN), data fusion technology is one of the important measures of reducing the data traffic, saving the energy of the nodes and prolonging network lifetime. In order to compress the data and improve the accuracy of the incident identification, a new hierarchical data fusion algorithm of WSN is proposed. On the side of sink nodes, the data from the sensor nodes is compressed by the least-square algorithm with a limited window, which reduces the communication traffic between sink nodes and the monitoring center; on the side of monitoring center, the incident identification accuracy is improved in D-S evidence theory recognition framework, by using the triangular fuzzy membership function to obtain the basic probability assignment (BPA) value.

articleTitle: Effects of selfishness in the opportunistic network under two different movement models
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Analyzing the effect of nodes' selfishness in the opportunistic network is a hot research. In previous studies, people only perform simulation scenarios under simple movement models. In practice, selfish nodes with different movement models will have different effects in the network. So it's necessary to study the effect of selfishness in the opportunistic network under different movement models. In real-life scenarios, the characteristics of the mobile node's movement is random and clustered. So, in this paper, we discuss how the selfishness of nodes affects performance of the opportunistic network with two movement models, the random walk model (RW) and the clustered movement model. With the experiments, we get the conclusion that effects of selfishness in the opportunistic network is related to the movement model.

articleTitle: Non-uniform quantization scheme for the decoding of low-density parity-check codes with the sum-product algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, a non-uniform quantization scheme is proposed for the decoding of Low-Density Parity-Check (LDPC) codes with the Sum-Product Algorithm (SPA). With the proposed scheme, the quantization-range and quantization-interval for the soft Log-Likelihood-Ratio (LLR) values of the decoder input, the variable nodes, and the check nodes are set separately, and are also adjusted according to the evolution of the probability density distribution of the LLR values in the iterative decoding procedure to minimize the difference between the decoding values before quantization and that after quantization. Simulation results show that decoding with 3-bit non-uniform quantization of the proposed scheme may obtain a BER performance slightly better than that of decoding with 6-bits quantization of the traditional uniform quantization method.

articleTitle: Path planning of UAV based on cultural algorithm in dynamic environments
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Due to the randomness of target and threats in complex dynamic environments, it is difficult to plan the path of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in real time. In this paper, we propose path planning of UAV based on cultural algorithm. The belief space consists of situational knowledge and normative knowledge. In the evolutionary process, extract some feature nodes as situational knowledge, and take variation ranges of the nodes as normative knowledge. Once initialized, the path is optimized under the guidance of knowledge in cultural algorithm. When the environment changes or the target moves, there is no need to regenerate the whole path to avoid threat. Only a part of the path, short-path or sub-path, needs to be readjusted. The simulation shows that cultural-algorithm-based path planning can track target and avoid threats rapidly in dynamic environments. Compared with D* algorithm, the proposed method has better real-time performance, lower path planning cost, and shorter length of the optimized path.

articleTitle: The method of interference source locating based on multi-beam antenna and analysis of locating accuracy
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Aiming at GEO communication satellites, this article investigates the method of single satellite interference source locating based on on-board multi-beam antennas. An interference source locating model is established and an equation set about locating is deduced. Simulations validate the effectiveness of the method and verify the great impact of the measurement error of signal strength, the beam pointing error and the vertical error on the locating accuracy.

articleTitle: WSN monitoring area partition clustering routing algorithm for energy-balanced
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to optimize the energy-balanced problem and lengthen the network lifetime for Wireless sensor network(WSN) monitoring, a routing protocol that based on monitoring area partition clustering for energy-balanced(EBPC) was proposed. We divided monitoring area into several virtual partitions, controlled the number of common nodes and clusters by data fusion rate, and forwarded cluster heads data to the next partitions with minimum path selection coefficient. Through performance analysis and simulation of EBPC reaches a conclusion that EBPC routing protocol has a superior balance of energy consumption than LEACH and EEUC, when data fusion rate is 0.5, network lifetime lengthen rate well be 1.3, and the effect of EEUC is more obvious when the data fusion rate have a lower value.

articleTitle: Weight optimized centroid localization algorithm on radioactive pollution monitoring by WSN for uranium tailings
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high cost of cable layout and poor maintenance in traditional radioactive pollution monitoring for uranium tailings, considering banded dam and little node connectivity, a weight optimized centroid localization algorithm is proposed. Under different index, by comparing the positioning accuracy and the influence of the external disturbance, new algorithm changes the index of weight and measured distance -1 to -1.5, resulting in an accuracy improvement in long distance. Simulation demonstrated that compared with centroid localization algorithm and maximum likelihood estimation, average positioning error of the new algorithm was reduced by 37.5% and 30.7%, and the maximum positioning error was reduced by 1/5 and by 2/5. With high reliability and stability, the new algorithm can meet the requirements of position in radioactive pollution monitoring for uranium tailings.

articleTitle: Delay and Doppler resolutions analysis of radar phase-coded pulse and frequency-coded pulse
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For classic radars, pulse compression is an important way to improve range and velocity resolution. And phase-coded and frequency-coded signals are two important means to implement pulse compression. In this paper, we analyze the lower bound of delay and Doppler resolutions of radar phase-coded pulse and frequency-coded pulse. The lower bound of the delay-Doppler resolution of phase-coded waveform is obtained. Meanwhile, the delay resolution of radar frequency-coded waveform is discussed and two useful propositions are gotten. We also get an approximate result for Doppler resolution of frequency-coded waveform. At last, the paper is concluded and future works are pointed out.

articleTitle: Interference alignment with hierarchical random vector quantization for MIMO interference channels
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Interference alignment (IA) boosts system throughput by effectively mitigating interference for high signal-to-noise (SNR) with perfect and global channel state information (CSI). In a system employ frequency division duplex (FDD), CSI is conveyed by feedback channel. Random vector quantization (RVQ) is widely used to reduce the overhead of feedback because it is easy to design and near-optimal, but suffer high computational complexity to find the best codeword. This paper derives the upper loss of the IA based system throughput due to quantization error of CSI, and proposes an IA scheme with hierarchical RVQ (HRVQ) to reduce effectively the computational complexity in the best codeword selection for CSI.

articleTitle: An improved principal component analysis method for railway accident prediction using uncertain data
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Uncertain data is an important issue in research of big data and railway accident prediction. In this paper, we introduce categories of uncertain data, and propose a method to deal with uncertain data in railway accident prediction. This method assumes that uncertain data obeys a special probability distribution, and then extracts features from the whole data using fuzzy principal component analysis (FPCA). Finally, employing total support vector classification (TSVC), railway accident prediction result is obtained, and the experiment shows that the prediction result has been risen by 5.02% compared to classical principal component analysis and support vector machine method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high reliable spaceborne reconfiguration system
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: As the improvement of the SRAM-based FPGA's production technology, the number of gates has reached 10 million-scale, it becomes more powerful, increasingly used in the space field. Due to the impact of space radiation, SRAM FPGA couldn't always be stable for space applications, it needs to strengthen reliability. High reliable spaceborne reconfiguration system is designed to ensure correct operation of the SRAM FPGA onboard. The system can achieve three functions: first, reconfiguring SRAM FPGA using external PROM or E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>PROM memory; second, accepting the ground configuration file and coding it in Hamming method, then storing it in E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>PROM; last, operating EDAC during idle time. The system can reduce the impact of SEU on SRAM FPGA, store different programs in E<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>PROM, realizing multiple functions in a single FPGA in different time. The cyclic EDAC function, not only guarantees configuration data correct in the E2PROM, but also achieves statistics of single event effect occurrence probability in external memory device, such as E2PROM.

articleTitle: An geographical adaptive routing algorithm based on overlapping area for uranium tailings radionuclide contamination monitoring in WSN
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: WSN can be applied to observe uranium tailings radionuclide contamination. Due to its energy constraint, a nice good clustering algorithm must use the network energy efficiently. For the lack of LEACH and GAF, an geographical adaptive routing algorithm based on overlapping area(GAOA)is proposed. The monitoring area is divided into a grid of circle according to location information of sensor node and intersecting circle structure. With residual energy and distance to the center within circle, the nodes will be selected as cluster heads. Then cluster heads choose the optimal next hop to transmit data to base station. As is shown in the experiment, the algorithm can save energy efficiently and prolong the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of gateway for hybrid antenna clustering routing algorithm in paddy monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSN) has unparalleled advantages and broad prospects in development of intelligent agriculture. As the bridge linking to external application system, gateway plays an important role in WSN. Different from the characteristics of traditional gateway equipment that mainly based on the planar routing network method and singly receiving and forwarding the data of sink node, in this paper a gateway that possesses energy self-sufficiency and fusing sink node function was designed based on clustering routing algorithm, which can improve the efficiency of data transmission and packet loss rate. Meanwhile, for the characteristics of large planting area, long monitoring cycle and strong interference to wireless signal transmission in the process of paddy environmental information collection, a clustering network method based on hybrid antenna was designed, and the paddy networking test was conducted combining with the gateway and networking method. Test result shows that the network packet loss rate is less than 3.8%, and the data transmission efficiency of gateway increased by 300%, This study could provide a reliable solution to the remote monitoring of large coverage area paddy.

articleTitle: HPC resources scheduling simulation using SimDAG
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Grid scheduling has been intensively studied, tools that enable the simulation of grids have been developed. These simulation tools have the common objective of developing and evaluating scheduling algorithms for grids. By using the simulation tools, knowledge about the behaviour of scheduling system will be more easily understood. However, knowledge about the method and how to use the tools is required. This paper will describe the use of SimDAG to simulate MinMin, MaxMin and HEFT scheduling algorithms in HPC.

articleTitle: Double-feedback image encryption based on chaotic dynamic grouping of FRFT
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) image encryption algorithm, according to the problem that one plain-text is correlated with one cipher-text encrypted, which can not resist chosen plaintext and chosen cipher-text attack, double-feedback image encryption method based on chaotic dynamic grouping oriented FRFT was proposed. Two chaotic systems were adopted in this method. Firstly, cipher-text feedback was introduced to drive the two systems. And the systems driven by feedback were utilized to encrypt: the keys of system 1 were utilized to realize the dynamic grouping on plain which was later utilized to realize the FRFT, and the first cipher-text was obtained. Then the keys of system 2 were utilized to realize the chaotic encryption on first cipher-text and obtain the second cipher-text. Analysis on Lyapunov index indicated that when feedback coefficient was less than 0.4, the Lyapunov index was more than zero, in which case the system was in chaotic state so that it could resist chosen plaintext attack and chosen cipher-text attack. Compared with the encryption method without feedback, the number of pixels change rate (NPCR) and unified average changing intensity (UACI) of encryption with feedback was improved by 0.5% and 1.49%, respectively. The results prove that the encryption with feedback can better resist differential attack, chosen plaintext attack and chosen cipher-text attack. Finally, the safety condition of system is pointed out that the feedback coefficient is less than 0.4, which provides a new method for evaluating the safety of the feedback system.

articleTitle: An efficient solution of circuit state assignment with immune algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Using state assignment to reduce area and power dissipation is important for the design of sequential circuits. In this paper, a new approach of state assignment using immune algorithm (IA)is proposed. The goal of the proposed IA is to find the optimal state assignment with low area and power dissipation. The proposed IA hybrid the immune operator and local search. Local search is adopt to prevent the premature convergence and remain the diversity of the whole population. The traditional crossover and mutation operator has been modified. Compared with published research, the proposed IA obtains a better state assignment that saves area and power dissipation.

articleTitle: Application of auditory perception in compressed sensing for speech signal
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper reports the application of auditory perception in the sparse representation and compressed sensing for speech signal. In order to obtain a more sparse representation, an experiment of sparse coefficients' selection under masking threshold method was done comparing with the energy threshold method, results indicate that the masking threshold method is more effective. In order to verify the impact of the method to compressed sensing for speech signal, the testing speeches were compressed under compressed sensing framework by masking threshold method and energy threshold method, through some subjective and objective indicators, such as compression ratio, signal noise ratio and mean opinion score, results imply that the masking threshold method can be applied effectively in compressed sensing, and can lead an increasing of compression ratio while the hearing quality of reconstructed signal is not decreased.

articleTitle: Novel noncoherent detectors for multi-branch multi-hop AF relaying
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Different new noncoherent detectors based on the logistic assumptions are proposed for multi-branch multi-hop amplify-and-forward (AF) relaying. Numerical results show that the improved energy detector with arbitrary power operation can achieve better bit error rate (BER) performance as the logistic detector based on the logistic assumption, and a larger number of hops requires a larger number of branches to achieve the same BER performance. Numerical results also show that when the SNR is large, the new detector based on the logistic approximation has better performances than the improved energy detector.

articleTitle: A dynamic TDMA protocol based on correlation in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In the applications of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), there are always significant correlations among the data from the neighboring nodes. To improve the channel utility, a Dynamic Time Division Multiple Access Control (DTDMA) is presented. It can adjust the allocation of time slots based on correlation to form the variable-length frames. The analysis indicates that the protocol can achieve good energy efficiency in the dynamic networks.

articleTitle: Adaptive crossover and crosstalk canceling DPD for MIMO transmitters
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Nonlinear and linear crosstalk effects where the paths are implemented on the same chipset cannot be avoided in multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) transceivers. This paper presents a crossover and crosstalk canceling digital predistortion (CCC-DPD) architecture, which can compensate the nonlinear crosstalk, linear crosstalk and nonlinearity of the power amplifier (PA). What's more, the linearization, nonlinear and linear crosstalk compensation are decoupled in CCC-DPD architecture. The simulation results show the proposed approach can effectively linearize the PA response and compensate the nonlinear and linear crosstalk with much smaller steady-state error than crossover digital predistortion (CO-DPD) and crosstalk canceling digital predistortion (CTC-DPD).

articleTitle: An adaptive UKF for nonlinear state estimation via maximum likelihood principle
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For the purpose of improving the performance of unscented Kalman filter (UKF) under the condition without accurate system noise statistics, this paper presents a new adaptive UKF based on the maximum likelihood principle. According to the maximum likelihood principle, the estimation of system noise statistics is determined by minimizing the negative of log likelihood function of innovation sequences. Subsequently, the estimated system noise statistics are fed back to the standard UKF to overcome its limitation. The proposed adaptive UKF can enhance the adaptive capability of standard UKF through the online estimation of system noise statistics. The effectiveness and advantage of the proposed algorithm are verified by the numerical simulations and comparison analysis.

articleTitle: Adaptive cubature Kalman filter for ultra-tightly coupled BDS/INS integration
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive cubature Kalman filter to improve the adaptivity of ultra-tightly coupled(UTC) BDS/INS (BeiDou Navigation Satellite System/Inertial Navigation System) integrated system against uncertainty involved in process noise statistic. This method adopts the hypothesis testing method to identify the uncertain process noise statistic and introduces a defined adaptive factor into the prediction covariance to decrease the weight of the prior knowledge on filtering solution. It corrects the state estimation in the occurrence of uncertain process noise statistics and avoids the loss of precision for the state estimation without process noise uncertainty. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified via the simulation of ultra-tightly coupled BDS/INS integrated system.

articleTitle: Mobility-based backoff algorithm with optimal window for vehicular network access
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: As a part of vehicular network, V2I communication plays an important role in many aspects such as internet access, traffic information acquisition, ETC and so on. IEEE 802.11p is one of the most widely used access protocol, which adopts binary exponential backoff algorithm (BEB). However, in vehicular environment, BEB algorithm can't make any adjustment with the change of real-time network status and high mobility of vehicles. It causes serious unfairness problems and a large amount of collisions under the condition of high-traffic vehicular network. This paper proposes an algorithm called MBAOW (Mobility-based Backoff Algorithm with Optimal Window), which uses a constant optimal contention window in backoff stage. The window can be adjusted with the the vehicle speed and the network status. The simulation results validated the effectiveness of MBAOW as well as the accuracy of the proposed model. The access performance including the fairness, reliability, throughput can be improved.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and optimization of inter process communication in Android
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Binder is the core inter process communication mechanism in Android System. We focused on the performance analysis and then designed experiments to compare Binder with the traditional IPC communication modes. Experimental results shows that Binder is suitable for small data transmission, while traditional IPC transmission, which has larger bandwidth and smaller delay, is more suitable for large data transmission; And with the increase of the number of concurrent, Binder performance decreases obviously. In order to explain this phenomenon, we further analyzed the internal function call mechanism of Binder. We found that Binder driver uses global kernel lock to ensure concurrent security, which brings performance loss. Therefore, we attempted to use the message queue Binder module to replace the Android default Binder module to verify the side effects of global lock. Finally, experiments proved that Binder performance was enhanced by more than 20% using message queue instead of global lock.

articleTitle: A brand new robust oriented near-threshold 8T SRAM design methodology
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Nanometer SRAM design is challenging because of the ever increasing process variation reducing the precious noise margin. This is especially true when the supply voltage are aggressively scaling at the same time for reducing the total power consumption. Traditional 6-T transistors are not capable of working in this condition, and it requires more complicated 8-T SRAM structure. To preserve a reasonable yield a 8-T SRAM must be designed by very carefully tuning the the threshold voltages of transistors. In contrast to 6-T SRAM design, the optimization of 8-T SRAMs is much less studied. In this paper, we propose a new 8-T structure and a comprehensive method for SRAM design relying on an efficient combination of performance optimization and yield analysis. Experiments show that traditional design which focuses only on optimizing the noise margins may lead to sub-optimal design which can not full fill the yield requirement. While the proposed yield oriented design method gives much better design which can be used in SRAM array design.

articleTitle: Research on interconnection mechanism between 6LoWPAN and Internet
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The diversity of architecture between wireless sensor network and conventional Internet leads to technical difficulties in integration of them. To solve the problem that 6LoWPAN nodes cannot directly communicate with IPv4 hosts located in Internet through full IP protocol, firstly, an interconnecting architecture based on 6LoWPAN edge router is proposed; secondly, a protocol translation mechanism is designed and implemented to translate IPv6 packets to IPv4 packets and vice versa; finally, experimental results and comparisons with other academic achievements demonstrate that the mechanism achieves peer-to-peer communication between Internet hosts and 6LoWPAN nodes with better packet-translation rate, processing delay and throughput, it promotes the extension of Internet to physical world.

articleTitle: Asymptotic orthogonality based decoders for satellite communication systems
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, for multiple access of satellite communication (SatCom) systems with M array elements of uniform linear array antennas at the satellite and with line-of-sight channels, the mutually asymptotic orthogonality of the channels is proved. Based on this, the maximum ratio combining (MRC) decoder and minimum mean squared error (MMSE) decoder based the achievable uplink rate are derived. Moreover, lower bounds foe these rates are given. Simulation results are shown to validate the tightness of the bounds of the achievable uplink rate.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of regular random LDPC codes
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to ensure the performance at the same time to reduce the complexity of the encoding and decoding, the paper focuses on the binary regular random LDPC codes of fast encoding and decoding and its hardware implementation method. This idea can be effectively realized by using upper triangular and lower triangular (LU) decomposition of the the minimal product of row weight and column weight as the principal component as well as the log domain decoding method. For FPGA design, the key is to solve the contradiction between the amount of resource, encoding and decoding efficiency, so as to achieve a higher efficiency of the compile at the same time the amount of resource is relatively small.

articleTitle: Metadata system modeling and testing
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the metadata plays a key role in the process of sharing information resources. The paper is a research of metadata management, to realize the metadata database, edit, import, export and query function. Some basic principles of metadata database and the design scheme of metadata management are presented.

articleTitle: Mode transition approach for large signal average models of PWM DC-DC converters
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: A new mode transition principle is proposed to solve the problem of mode transition between CCM (Continuous Current Mode) and DCM (Discontinuous Current Mode) of the PWM switching converter's large signal average models. Simulation results prove that the proposed mode transition principle can better reflect the large signal dynamic behaviors of the PWM switching converters.

articleTitle: Optimization of detection area for intelligent optical-fiber material
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Utility control decisions and corresponding control system for sensor network ensures the operational reliability of intelligent structure, while determine the sensitive area of sensor network affect effectiveness of network signal and correctness of covering location for sensor network. This paper propose granular computing method based on rough set, which is a good match for intelligent optical-fiber material used to detect sensitive areas. After studying fiber optic smart mezzanine sensing network, we obtained the sensitive area distribution and covering location for sensor network. Through the analysis to recognize that this method can not only detect sensitive areas, but also make sensor network signal simplified.

articleTitle: Target detection and tracking analysis of moving object based on PCLFM simulated model for airborne satellite communication
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Pulse Compression Linear Frequency Modulation (PCLFM) waveform is widely used in wideband radars such as Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR). But the LFM waveform suffers from range migration, if the target to be detected and it has a high velocity that the pulses cannot be coherently integrated. A novel method based on wideband matched filter is proposed to eliminate the effect of speed. Both theory analysis and simulations shows that the new method can integrate the energy of the echo reflected from the target effectively.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of NAPT function in border gateway based on LKM
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: A function of Network Address Port Translation (NAPT) is designed and implemented based on Loadable Kernel Modules (LKM) for boarder gateway to meet the require of processing efficiency and performance in scene of the space-air-ground integrated network. In this paper, the NAPT is designed to be a LKM in border gateway for excellent flexibility, extensibility and maintainability. And it is loaded into the Network Layer to achieve its functions by using Netfilter subsystem in Linux kernel. The framework, algorithm, flow chart, and key data structure are given. The experimental results show that the gateway successfully implements NAPT function and have excellent processing efficiency and performance: The throughput achieves over 94Mbits/s data transmission rate on 100M-Ethernet network-card. Moreover, the NAPT processing delay in gateway is about 0.010ms. And, when the sending rate of Jperf is set to 100Mbits/s, the Round Trip Transfer time (RTT) of TCP is about 1.60ms.

articleTitle: Fault injection method and voter design for dual modual redundancy FPGA hardening
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Hardware overhead and system reliability has always been in a dilemma in the world of FPGA designing. This paper provides a hardware overhead free dual modular redundancy (DMR) voter scheme using the abundant and unused carry chains in Xilinx FPGAs. And the experimental evaluation on MCNC benchmarks are carried on real FPGA and logic-simulation based fault injection method, respectively. Experimental results under the two methods are identical; hence validates the effectiveness of logic-simulation method and the DMR hardening scheme we have designed.

articleTitle: A research on 3D fusion location algorithm of spatial-time domain based on MUSIC algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, the new 3D fusion localization algorithm model based on the multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm is proposed to integrate space distance positioning with time delay positioning. Space-time cascade approach enhances the receiver to receive signal strength in the range of signal source direction and the multidimensional spectrum peak search only needed in corresponding scope. Space-time fusion approach can match the airspace-domain parameters with time-domain parameters to estimate and handle the estimation problem in which source number is greater than the number of array element. The simulation results show that the accuracy of the signal source is estimated by using the 3D fusion location algorithm model when the pitching angle is less than 70°.

articleTitle: Hardware implementation of adaptive filter for UWB radio fuze
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This work analyses, implements and modifies the adaptive filter structure to improve the SNR of the detection signal in UWB fuze, based in the LMS algorithm (Least Mean Square). The adaptive niter implementation is made in a Texas Instruments (TI) Digital signal Processor TMS320F28335 to reduce noise and recognize the target characteristic information in UWB fuze system.

articleTitle: Low-complexity algorithm and circuit design of correlation for time delay estimation
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Time delay estimation (TDE) is of great importance in a TDOA based location finding system and cross correlation is a typical method of TDE. This paper presents a new index named Equivalent One-bit Adding Times (EOAT) to evaluate algorithm's computation on bit level, based on which a low-complexity method of correlation is presented, meanwhile, we deduce the sufficient condition under which new method could be used, where condition coefficient F is put forward whose value is decided by input signal's nature, sampling rate and ADC's bits. At last, circuits are designed and experimental results show that improved method cost less circuit resources than traditional method with different degree as F equals to different value. Experimental data shows that if F<;1, improved method take advantage. While F<;0.05, circuit resources improved method cost are 50% less than that cost by traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: CDMA-based watermarking schemes in DWT domain
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: CDMA-based watermarking is an effective technique since the watermark energy is dispersed over a large number of frequencies and the watermark energy embedded into each frequency is small. Due to the fact that, in the subspace spanned by the spreading codes, it is hard to find a projection vector which is approximated closely to the original cover image vector to significantly degrade the influence of cover image on the accuracy of watermark extraction. It motivates us to propose a variance-reduction technique to enhance the robustness of watermarking scheme in this paper.

articleTitle: A low cost design of hardware support for on-chip message passing in manycore processors
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a low cost hardware support for on-chip message passing mechanism in manycore processors. Data sharing is an important problem for manycore processor. As the scale of manycore processors increases, the penalty of multicasts from cache coherence protocol increases dramatically, which restricts the performance of on-chip communications. In order to improve the performance of inter-core communications, message passing is introduced into manycore processors. On-chip message passing buffers are designed to supply high performance message passing in manycore processors, which takes about 5.26% on-chip storage area. However, the utilization of on-chip storage is low due to the usage of lightweight cores in manycore processors, in which computing and data transmission will not work simultaneously. This paper proposes a message passing scheme via reusing the cache memories and logical circuits in state machine from original cache coherence protocols. With reusing of cache memories, only 0.01% overhead in hardware costs are required to gain the similar performance with original message passing design. And our design with the same hardware costs gains 11% improvements in overall performance.

articleTitle: Frequency analysis of fall detection based on Android system
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to solve a hot issue about the elderly fall, this paper designs a software algorithm system based on the frequency analysis. This software can judge whether the elderly fall down, so as to take subsequent rescue measures. The paper carries on the analysis from the frequency domain. By using the acceleration sensor to get the information of human body state continuously and with the aid of subsection processing, the software can determine whether the body is in a state of fall. The core of the frequency domain analysis method is to add window to data and use STFT. Because of the particularity of acceleration frequency in the process of the fall, the algorithm can be more accurate to judge whether the elderly fall down.

articleTitle: Study on relevance between crude oil output and meteorological factors based on NCM-Apriori
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Crude oil output is directly or indirectly associated with a number of factors such as reserves, geological structure, number of active wells, and production plan. Analysis of relationship between crude oil output and influencing factors plays a significant role in predicting crude oil output and planning reasonable productions. A method using NCM-Apriori algorithm to calculate the relevance between crude oil output and meteorological factors is proposed in this paper. With this method, data pre-processing based on K-Means algorithm is first conducted on daily production data of a certain oil production plant. Next, different meteorological factors are graded to achieve transaction datasets. An association analysis with NCM-Apriori algorithm is then performed on these datasets. Finally, the strong association rules related to crude oil output are selected based on settings for minimum support and minimum confidence. This method has been proven to be more simple and efficient than traditional Apriori algorithms in computation, thus providing a new reference for predicting crude oil output and developing reasonable crude oil production plans.

articleTitle: Research on reinforcing mesh for vertical antenna radiant protection
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Reinforcing mesh is useful for shielding electromagnetic field, and its cost is low, construction is simple, performance is good. It takes vertical antenna for example, studying how erecting reinforcing mesh, grounding reinforcing mesh, and erecting horizontal/vertical reinforcing mesh effect its radiant protection, while making sure that its radiant is weak and field suppression is strong, so as to providing reference for practical application of high power shortwave antenna electromagnetic radiation protection.

articleTitle: Directed graphical game based joint channel selection and power control in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This article investigates the problem of achieving global optimization for joint channel selection and power control in the cognitive radio networks. Existing schemes modeled the local interference relationship in channel selection by undirected graphs, which however, failed to characterize the directed interference property. In this paper, we reveal the directed and local interference relationship among neighbor cells and propose a directed graphical game to study the distributed channel and power selection problem. Specifically, each transmitter-receiver pair is abstracted as a network access point, that is, a player in the proposed game, among which the interference is abstracted as a directed edge. Then, we prove that the game possesses at least one pure strategy Nash equilibrium. Finally, we propose a joint channel and power selection algorithm, which does not need a controller, to achieve Nash equilibriums. According to the simulation results, the proposed algorithm outperforms the existing schemes in undirected game formulations.

articleTitle: Meteor trail interference of owe density suppression algorithm based on DWT-WF-CP in OTHR
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In general, meteor trail interference of owe density (MTIOD) can degrade target detection performance of over-thehorizon radar (OTHR). By exploiting MTIOD suppression algorithm based on dyadic wavelet transform (DWT), window function (WF) and CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) decomposition, an effective approach is proposed to solve the problem. The position of MTIOD is calculated through utilizing DWT and WF. Therefore, with the data involved in the position, Hankel tensor of three orders is constituted. CP algorithm is applied to resolve the obtained Hankel tensor so as to attain the parameters of MTIOD. On the basis of these parameters, echo signal of MTIOD in time domain is generated. After excising MTIOD from echo data, echo signal without MTIOD is achieved. Compared with the existing MTIOD suppression methods, experimental results have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method which not just improves computational accuracy of the position of MTIOD, but decreases remnant of MTIOD after interference suppression.

Author Keywords: meteor trail interference of owe density

articleTitle: The research on improvement of narrowband radio channel communication protocol based on fountain codes
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The narrowband radio channel has narrow bandwidth, high error bit rate, and long transmission delay so that traditional TCP protocol can not transmit data effectively. To solve this problem, an improved communication protocol based on fountain codes was put forward. Utilizing the principle of fountain codes, data was split into some small data before they were transmitted, and small data were transmitted continuously until the receiver replied to the acknowledgement message. The simulation result shows that under the same transmission environment, the improved protocol can enhance the efficiency of data transmission compared to the traditional TCP protocol.

articleTitle: Design of microstrip mini-antenna on X-band
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to meet the calibration of the TT&C system on X-band, the corresponding beacon antenna needs to be designed. According to the requirement of antenna design, the high-order mode microstrip antenna is used for the design. By simulation and optimization of the HFSS, miniaturization antenna structure requirements have been met. The antenna is designed with light weight, low profile, low cost, easy to manufacture packaging and so on. After testing antenna meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: HCGM-based high-efficiency temperature evaluation scheme for NoCs
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Temperature evaluation is a key point to the static power calculation and thermal management for application mapping. This paper proposes a design-time (offline) Heat Conduction Grid Model (HCGM) to evaluate the temperature of network-on-chip, which is based on the temperature dependency on heat flux density produced by ambient tiles as well as itself. This model incorporates short running time and high accuracy; reasonable temperature variation trend of each tile; high operability and consumability. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can speedup the computation by around 184 times with accuracy decreased by 1.39% as compared to HotSpot.

articleTitle: Quard-phase complete complementary sequences-based MIMO channel estimation
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the wireless communications growing rapidly, we need great-performance and high-efficiency channel estimation. An estimation method based on the quadri-phase complete complementary sequences (CCs) is proposed for the Multiple-Input and Multiple-Output (MIMO) systems. A time slot structure that using CCs with optimal periodic autocorrelations as cyclic prefix (CP) and zero padded (ZP) suffix is investigated. With the pilot blocks of CCs, optimal least square (LS) estimation in the minimum mean square error (MMSE) is got. In addition, with the appropriate length CCs, higher accuracy channel estimation will be achieved. To reduce the waste of frequency spectrum that pilot blocks usage, the same blocks would include the training sequences and the data. Analytical and simulation results demonstrate that the method is available and obtainable.

articleTitle: The progress of stochastic resonance in the application of spectrum sensing
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Spectrum sensing is a key technology of cognitive radio network. Firstly, the paper introduced the latest research progress of the application of the stochastic resonance in cognitive radio spectrum sensing, including stochastic resonance in the local field of sensing (such as energy detection, covariance matrix spectrum sensing, cyclostationary feature detection) and the application of collaborative sensing, and then it pointed out some problems of the stochastic resonance to be solved in the cognitive radio spectrum sensing. Last but not the least, the next research directions were summarized.

articleTitle: The design of indoor positioning prototype based on Wi-Fi
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Indoor positioning has wide prospects in emergency positioning, public safety, and exhibition services and has become a research focus. This paper presents a 2D indoor positioning system based on Wi-Fi and TDOA on USRP platform. Meanwhile, the sending and receiving of Wi-Fi signal are implemented for measurement and the algorithm of frequency offset estimation, initial phase estimation and the cross correlation method are introduced. At last, experiments show that it could work and display correctly and reach an accuracy and precision of 0.3 m.

articleTitle: Fault reparation time estimation based on exponential distribution function and software instability metric
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Software maintenance phase contains modifying, training and help supporting. In this phase when faults occur, users will notify the problem to software maintenance team. The team has to provide the users the estimated fault reparation time and then fix the problems. Fault reparation time of different kinds of faults may be varied due to fault types and program instability. In this research, an estimation model for fault reparation time is proposed. The exponential probability density function and an instability metric are mainly used to construct the estimation model. The estimation model is exercised with some open source software projects. The experiment result shows the model constructed by applying both theory of exponential distribution and instability metric is significantly better than the model constructed by applying only theory of exponential distribution.

articleTitle: Author index
publicationTitle: 2016 6th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Presents an index of the authors whose articles are published in the conference proceedings record.
